# LINSILK

> LINSILK is a made-to-measure clothing house based in Geneva, Switzerland, working in silk, linen and high frequency fabrics. Every piece except the ties is cut and sewn to the customer's own measurements in 2–4 weeks, in 100% silk, 100% linen or high frequency fabric.

Pieces are ordered online: choose a piece, choose its colour from swatches of its cloth (48 silk colours, 40 linen colours, 12 cashmere colours), enter 15 measurements. There are no fittings; customers measure themselves or use any tailor. Orders are dispatched from Geneva with tracking. Contact: hello@bylinsilk.com.

## The house

- [About LINSILK](https://bylinsilk.com/about): what the house is, with the facts at a glance
- [How made-to-measure works](https://bylinsilk.com/made-to-measure): ordering, price, fittings, timing
- [The cloth](https://bylinsilk.com/cloth): pure silk (plain, jacquard, brocade), pure linen and cashmere
- [Questions](https://bylinsilk.com/care/questions): the answer bank
